what: First Russian shadow fleet vessel enters Channel since Smyrtos boarding

clean_source_blocks.text: A Russian "shadow fleet" tanker has entered the English Channel for the first time since UK forces boarded the Smyrtos early on Sunday morning, ship tracking data reviewed by BBC Verify shows. Forwarder, a Russian-flagged ship that left port in Primorsk last week, entered the Channel on Wednesday evening and sailed south. It is broadcasting its final destination as Dongying port in China. UK-sanctioned shadow fleet vessels have avoided the Channel since British troops intercepted the Smyrtos, with tracking data showing a number of sanctioned ships altering course to avoid the waterway in the aftermath of the operation. BBC Verify has approached the Ministry of Defence (MoD) for comment. Ship-tracking data appears to show a Royal Navy warship, HMS Tyne, operating in the area near the tanker's location.
Forwarder, a Russian-flagged ship which left port in Primorsk last week, entered the Channel on Wednesday evening.

The day before the charges were filed, Royal Marine Commandos and officers from the National Crime Agency boarded the MV Smyrtos in the English Channel. It was, by all accounts, a first: the UK’s inaugural boarding of a sanctioned Russian shadow fleet tanker. Pant is accused of delivering prohibited Russian oil to a third country. The vessel is currently being held off the UK’s south coast while investigators continue their work. Pant is set to appear at Southampton Magistrates’ Court on June 16, 2026. The shadow fleet is a network of aging tankers, often registered under obscure flags and insured by unknown entities, that transport Russian crude and refined products to buyers willing to look the other way. Since 2022, when Western nations imposed sweeping energy sanctions following Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, this fleet has reportedly tripled in size.

British forces boarded and seized a sanctioned Russian oil tanker in the English Channel in the early hours of Sunday, in what the Ministry of Defence (MoD) described as the first UK-led operation of its kind. The vessel, named as the Smyrtos, was intercepted by Royal Marine commandos and specially trained officers from the National Crime Agency during a six-hour operation. It is being held off the south coast of England as investigations continue. The seizure is the first time Britain has led an interdiction of a shadow fleet vessel in its own waters, after months in which UK assets had supported similar operations by allies.

original_article.research:
[Lähde: BBC World]
A Russian "shadow fleet" tanker has entered the English Channel for the first time since UK forces boarded the Smyrtos early on Sunday morning, ship tracking data reviewed by BBC Verify shows.

Forwarder, a Russian-flagged ship that left port in Primorsk last week, entered the Channel on Wednesday evening and sailed south. It is broadcasting its final destination as Dongying port in China.

UK-sanctioned shadow fleet vessels have avoided the Channel since British troops intercepted the Smyrtos, with tracking data showing a number of sanctioned ships altering course to avoid the waterway in the aftermath of the operation.

BBC Verify has approached the Ministry of Defence (MoD) for comment.

Ship-tracking data appears to show a Royal Navy warship, HMS Tyne, operating in the area near the tanker's location.

Forwarder was sanctioned by the UK, the US and the EU in 2025. Since the British government accused it of smuggling oil from Russia, the vessel has changed its name twice.

Satellite imagery showed Forwarder left Primorsk on 12 June after loading oil. The refinery is the largest in the Baltic Sea and is a critical export hub for Russia's energy industry.

Shadow fleet tankers such as Forwarder have provided a critical lifeline for the Kremlin since the West imposed sanctions on its energy exports in the wake of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

The clandestine fleet of more than 700 ageing tankers, usually of obscured ownership, is responsible for carrying 75% of Russia's sanctioned oil, according to the MoD.

A Nato official has previously told BBC Verify that the Russian warship, Admiral Grigorovich, has been assigned to escort sanctioned oil tankers. But it is unclear whether the frigate is accompanying the Forwarder.

Admiral Grigorovich was involved in an incident on Tuesday when it fired warning shots towards a British yacht that had apparently moved towards it in the Channel.

A Nato official told BBC Verify that, as of Wednesday evening, Admiral Grigorovich had not moved far from the location of the incident.

But experts told BBC Verify it was unlikely the UK or France would seek to intercept the tanker.

Royal Marine Commandos intercepted the MV Smyrtos in the first UK-led boarding of a sanctioned Russian shadow fleet vessel, with the captain now facing up to 10 years in prison

British authorities have charged the captain of an oil tanker with breaching Russian sanctions, marking a sharp escalation in the UK’s enforcement campaign against the so-called shadow fleet that helps Moscow skirt Western restrictions on its energy exports.

Ajay Pant, a 38-year-old Indian national who captained the MV Smyrtos, was charged on June 15, 2026, under the Russia (Sanctions) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019. He faces up to 10 years in prison if convicted.

The day before the charges were filed, Royal Marine Commandos and officers from the National Crime Agency boarded the MV Smyrtos in the English Channel. It was, by all accounts, a first: the UK’s inaugural boarding of a sanctioned Russian shadow fleet tanker.

Pant is accused of delivering prohibited Russian oil to a third country. The vessel is currently being held off the UK’s south coast while investigators continue their work.

Pant is set to appear at Southampton Magistrates’ Court on June 16, 2026.

The shadow fleet is a network of aging tankers, often registered under obscure flags and insured by unknown entities, that transport Russian crude and refined products to buyers willing to look the other way. Since 2022, when Western nations imposed sweeping energy sanctions following Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, this fleet has reportedly tripled in size.

The UK has been ramping up its response. The government has sanctioned over 135 of these vessels, including companies like Intershipping Services LLC, as part of a broader strategy to choke off Russia’s ability to finance its military operations through oil revenue.

There is also a compliance dimension worth watching. Shipping companies, insurers, and commodity traders who have been operating near the edges of sanctions law now have a concrete example of criminal prosecution to consider. A captain facing a decade in prison is a powerful deterrent, and it’s likely to ripple through the industry’s risk calculations.

The tripling of the shadow fleet since 2022 shows how much economic activity has been built on the assumption that these sanctions would remain loosely enforced.

payload.title: Venäläinen varjolaivaston tankkeri saapui Englannin kanaaliin Smyrtos-operaation jälkeen
payload.summary: Venäjän lipun alla purjehtiva Forwarder on saapunut Englannin kanaaliin ensimmäisenä venäläisenä varjolaivaston aluksena sen jälkeen, kun Britannian joukot nousivat Smyrtos-tankkerille varhain sunnuntaina.
payload.content:
Venäjän lipun alla kulkeva Forwarder-tankkeri saapui keskiviikkoiltana Englannin kanaaliin ja jatkoi etelään, BBC Verifyn tarkastelemat alusseurantatiedot osoittavat. Kyseessä on ensimmäinen venäläiseen niin kutsuttuun varjolaivastoon liitetty alus, jonka on kerrottu tulleen kanaaliin sen jälkeen, kun Britannian joukot nousivat pakotteiden kohteena olleelle Smyrtos-tankkerille varhain sunnuntaina.

## Forwarder kulki kanaaliin keskiviikkona

Forwarder oli lähtenyt Primorskin satamasta edellisellä viikolla. Aluksen lähettämän määränpäätiedon mukaan sen lopullinen kohde on Dongyingin satama Kiinassa. Alusseurantatietojen mukaan alus eteni kanaaliin keskiviikkoiltana ja purjehti sen jälkeen etelään.

Britannian pakotteiden kohteena olevien varjolaivaston alusten on kerrottu vältelleen Englannin kanaalia Smyrtos-operaation jälkeen. Seurantatietojen mukaan useat pakotetut alukset muuttivat kurssiaan välttääkseen vesiväylän operaation jälkimainingeissa. Samojen tietojen perusteella Britannian kuninkaallisen laivaston HMS Tyne -sotalaivan on havaittu toimivan alueella lähellä tankkerin sijaintia. Britannian puolustusministeriöltä on pyydetty kommenttia asiasta.

## Smyrtos otettiin haltuun tutkintaa varten

Britannian joukot nousivat Smyrtos-tankkerille Englannin kanaalissa sunnuntain varhaisina tunteina. Operaatioon osallistui Royal Marines -kommandosotilaita sekä Britannian kansallisen rikosviraston erityiskoulutettuja virkamiehiä. Kuusi tuntia kestäneen operaation jälkeen alus otettiin haltuun, ja sitä pidetään Englannin etelärannikon edustalla tutkinnan jatkuessa.

Britannian puolustusministeriö kuvasi Smyrtos-operaatiota ensimmäiseksi Britannian johtamaksi toiminnaksi laatuaan. Kyse oli myös ensimmäisestä kerrasta, kun Britannia johti varjolaivaston aluksen pysäyttämistä omilla vesillään, vaikka Britannian resursseja oli aiemmin käytetty liittolaisten vastaavien operaatioiden tukemiseen.

## Varjolaivasto liittyy pakotteiden kiertämiseen

Varjolaivastolla tarkoitetaan ikääntyvien tankkereiden verkostoa, jonka alukset kuljettavat venäläistä raakaöljyä ja öljytuotteita ostajille pakotteiden aikana. Alukset on usein rekisteröity epäselvien lippujen alle, ja niiden vakuutustiedot voivat olla vaikeasti jäljitettäviä.

Länsimaat asettivat laajoja energiapakotteita Venäjälle sen hyökättyä Ukrainaan vuonna 2022. Lähdetietojen mukaan varjolaivaston koko on sen jälkeen kasvanut merkittävästi, mikä on lisännyt alusten liikkeisiin ja pysäytyksiin kohdistuvaa huomiota Englannin kanaalin kaltaisilla vilkkailla merialueilla.
summary_bullets: Forwarder-tankkeri saapui Englannin kanaaliin keskiviikkoiltana ja jatkoi etelään.
Kyse on ensimmäisestä venäläisestä varjolaivaston aluksesta kanaalissa Smyrtos-operaation jälkeen.
Smyrtos pidetään Englannin etelärannikon edustalla tutkinnan jatkuessa.
payload.journalist_note: Artikkeli perustuu paketin alusseurantaa, Forwarderin liikkeitä ja Smyrtos-operaatiota koskeviin tietoihin. Epävarmat tai irralliset henkilötiedot jätettiin pois, koska ne eivät ole jutun ytimen kannalta välttämättömiä.

Lähdetietojen mukaan varjolaivaston koko on sen jälkeen kasvanut merkittävästi, mikä on lisännyt alusten liikkeisiin ja pysäytyksiin kohdistuvaa huomiota Englannin kanaalin kaltaisilla vilkkailla merialueilla.

A Russian "shadow fleet" tanker has entered the English Channel for the first time since UK forces boarded the Smyrtos early on Sunday morning, ship tracking data reviewed by BBC Verify shows. Forwarder, a Russian-flagged ship that left port in Primorsk last week, entered the Channel on Wednesday evening and sailed south. It is broadcasting its final destination as Dongying port in China. UK-sanctioned shadow fleet vessels have avoided the Channel since British troops intercepted the Smyrtos, with tracking data showing a number of sanctioned ships altering course to avoid the waterway in the aftermath of the operation. BBC Verify has approached the Ministry of Defence (MoD) for comment. Ship-tracking data appears to show a Royal Navy warship, HMS Tyne, operating in the area near the tanker's location.

The day before the charges were filed, Royal Marine Commandos and officers from the National Crime Agency boarded the MV Smyrtos in the English Channel. It was, by all accounts, a first: the UK’s inaugural boarding of a sanctioned Russian shadow fleet tanker. Pant is accused of delivering prohibited Russian oil to a third country. The vessel is currently being held off the UK’s south coast while investigators continue their work. Pant is set to appear at Southampton Magistrates’ Court on June 16, 2026. The shadow fleet is a network of aging tankers, often registered under obscure flags and insured by unknown entities, that transport Russian crude and refined products to buyers willing to look the other way. Since 2022, when Western nations imposed sweeping energy sanctions following Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, this fleet has reportedly tripled in size.

British forces boarded and seized a sanctioned Russian oil tanker in the English Channel in the early hours of Sunday, in what the Ministry of Defence (MoD) described as the first UK-led operation of its kind. The vessel, named as the Smyrtos, was intercepted by Royal Marine commandos and specially trained officers from the National Crime Agency during a six-hour operation. It is being held off the south coast of England as investigations continue. The seizure is the first time Britain has led an interdiction of a shadow fleet vessel in its own waters, after months in which UK assets had supported similar operations by allies.
